title: P07: Triage→ASB Live Lane Dispatch Adapter
mission: Implement machine-executable dispatch adapter for Triage lanes with receipt contracts. Close remaining AUTONOMY_GAP by executing ready lanes from ingested manifests and emitting structured receipts.
safeParallelWork: Provider runtime work not touching triage-consumer
P67 OpenCode evaluation adapter work in tooling/evals/p67-opencode-adapter/**
Other harness or app work using separate branches
forbiddenScope: Claiming live CloudAgent PASS without observed execution
Deleting panels or requiring human paste/proceed
expectedArtifacts: Dispatch policy JSON with fail-closed enforcement

Create dispatch policy and receipt schema

Executes local-argv lanes with subprocess and captures exit codes

Emits BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED for runtime-tool without faking success

proof.achieved: Local argv lanes execute with exit codes. CloudAgent/runtime-tool emit structured BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED receipts. Receipt JSON validates against schema.
proof.ceiling: CloudAgent path documented as BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED until live CloudAgent adapter integrated in future phase. Does NOT prove live CloudAgent dispatch or runtime tool integration.
